name: Mnemonic Fist
description: Strike on a single word of cue so the whole drilled form runs out of the fist without a pause.

name: Cue Guard
description: Drop into a drilled guard at a cue from a comrade before the blow is seen.

name: Index Sense
description: Index the signs of a fight in the mind so each sign can be looked up and read again later.

name: Cued Step
description: Move on a cue into the exact spot rehearsed for that cue.

name: Cue Release
description: Release a stored cue that sets an ally into the whole of a drilled response at once.

name: Foggy Recall
description: Cloud a foe's recall of the last few moves so the foe doubts which stance is next.

name: Held Strike
description: Strike with the exact timing held in memory from a bout fought earlier with the same foe.

name: Kept Guard
description: Raise a guard at the exact angle that a past blow from this foe came in on.

name: Recall Thread
description: Pull one thread of a half-forgotten scene back to full clarity.

name: Kept Step
description: Take the step that the memory says saved the user last time.

name: Kept Cue
description: Remind an ally of a drilled response by speaking its cue in the voice the ally learned it in.

name: Recollect Jab
description: Jab at a point the user recollects the foe failed to defend a breath ago.

name: Mind Clearing
description: Clear the clouded mind of an ally who took a heavy blow by laying the ally's last clear moment back over it.

name: Recall Counter
description: Meet a move the foe has used before with a counter prepared for exactly that move and break its flow.

name: Reverie Fist
description: Throw a fist from a half-dreaming calm in which the body does what it remembers.

name: Reverie Screen
description: Draw a thin screen of drifting recollection round the body that softens the first impact.

name: Reverie Sensing
description: Drift into a waking reverie and let the memory of a place show who passed through it.

name: Wandering Pace
description: Wander across the ground on the half-remembered lines of an old route and arrive unhurried.

name: Reverie Word
description: Say a murmured word that settles an ally into a calm remembered rhythm of action.

name: Waking Call
description: Call an ally out of a dazing trance or a false remembered scene back to the present.

name: Reverie Snare
description: Draw a foe into a half-waking remembered scene and hold the foe there while the real fight goes on.

name: Faithful Fist
description: Throw a fist that is a true copy of the best strike the user has ever thrown.

name: Faithful Guard
description: Hold a guard that does not drift out of shape however long the pressure lasts.

name: Faithful Eye
description: Take in a scene with a faithful eye that sets no detail aside and holds all of them equally clear.

name: Faithful Step
description: Repeat a proven step exactly and arrive on the same mark as before.

name: Faithful Record
description: Record a whole scene in perfect memory so it can be replayed without a single detail lost.

name: Memory Ward
description: Ward the mind against a probe that would read or twist the memory and let the probe slide away.

name: Layered Strike
description: Strike with several old strike patterns laid over each other so the blow lands in a way the foe cannot place.

name: Piled Guard
description: Pile guard over guard in memory so a break in one leaves another still standing.

name: Layer Reading
description: Read the top layer of a worn place and then the one under it.

name: Stacked Step
description: Step on top of the foot-marks of an earlier step so the trail reads as a single walker.

name: Layer Word
description: Lay a clear instruction over an ally's muddled memory so the ally acts on it.

name: Scrape Touch
description: Scrape at the top layer of a foe's recollection so the foe cannot place the last thing seen.

name: Mending Recall
description: Mend a mind that has been overwritten by a false recollection and bring the true layer back up.

name: Overwrite Blow
description: Strike and write a false picture of the exchange over the foe's recollection of it.

name: Scraped Clean
description: Scrape a lingering technique pattern out of the air before the foe can lean on it for the next move.
